_comment: Pi project settings. Overrides ~/.pi/settings.json for this project. Remove any key you want to inherit from global. Delete this file entirely if you have no project-specific overrides.
_defaultThinkingLevel_comment: How much internal reasoning the model does before responding. Options: 'off', 'minimal', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh'. 'medium' is a good default for structured work. Use 'high'/'xhigh' for complex architectural decisions. Use 'low'/'off' for routine edits.

tools._comment: Per-tool permission policy. 'allow' = no confirmation prompt. 'ask' = prompts user before executing. 'deny' = blocked entirely. Safety extensions (see .pi/extensions/) layer additional enforcement on top of these settings.

compaction._comment: Context compaction behavior. 'enabled: true' triggers auto-summarization when context fills. 'reserveTokens' is kept free for the agent's next response. 'keepRecentTokens' is preserved verbatim before summarization. Pi-memory writes a handoff entry to daily log on compaction.

_skills_comment: Paths to skill files. Pi discovers skills from these globs at startup — names and descriptions enter the system prompt, full content loads on demand. Paths are relative to project root. Supports glob patterns.
_extensions_comment: Paths to TypeScript extension files. Extensions hook into pi's event lifecycle (before_agent_start, tool_call, session_start, etc.) and run with full system permissions. Install community extensions via 'pi install git:...' or 'pi install npm:...'. Drop custom .ts files into .pi/extensions/.
_enableSkillCommands_comment: Enables /skill:name syntax for direct skill invocation — skills appear in autocomplete without a routing table match. Useful for ad-hoc skill calls. Set false to require explicit routing table dispatch.

retry._comment: Retry behavior for failed LLM calls. 'maxAttempts' is total attempt count. 'baseDelay'/'maxDelay' control exponential backoff in milliseconds.

env._comment: Environment variables loaded before extensions run. The '_file' key tells pi to load a .env file at the given path (project-relative). Copy .pi/.env.example → .pi/.env and set PI_PROJECT_ID. .pi/.env is gitignored — never commit it.
